contentList.content: The blade still hums, though the note has gone wrong somewhere. Those who hear it sometimes forget why they drew a weapon at all.

While your off hand is empty, your melee weapon deals an extra [1].

Effectiveness increases from your Charisma Modifier.
No one has seen the string this note came from. The echo outlasts the blow and settles somewhere behind the eyes.

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against enemies suffering from <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_PSYCHIC_MENTAL_FATIGUE">Mental Fatigue</LSTag>.
